title: Ledger Flex from Challenger VivoCity, Singapore

purchase.price: S$399.00 (member price S$389.00), from the shelf sticker

implant.notes: An extra flex PCB with a coax antenna lead is attached to the inside of the back cover. Its silkscreen ends in "V1.2"; the Chinese characters in the middle are not legible in the photos.

sources.author: Era
